description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Dispute between Standard Chartered bank Vs Ceylon Bank Employees Union (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a bank and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary structures, allowances, and working conditions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for employment relations, made under statutory authority.
